mostWorthwhile.text: Load-testing the working radios was most worthwhile: comparing actual demand with usable battery capacity made the overnight plan credible rather than just hopeful.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate battery protection and connection steps felt somewhat repetitive, particularly with only one option available by then.

surprise.text: The solar kits add no energy tonight; the link must depend on the reserves until daylight.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though several were simply the only offered combination rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: Yes. Eli's reply gives the repair a personal payoff, and Tin Row's offer makes me curious how the separate networks might communicate.
